title: Airport Circling District
previewText: The Airport Circling District comprises those parts of the flight obstruction area of any major airport which lie generally below the flight path of aircraft circling such airport and, more specifically, below the following airport referenced imaginary surfaces: those parts of the horizontal surface and the conical surface which do not coincide with the approach surfaces and the transitional surfaces.
